description: This horizontal grouped bar chart illustrates the difference in average Word Error Rate (WER) from the Whisper large model across various applied optimizations for two different models. The vertical axis contains the categories, labeled "Optimisations applied," listing "Normalised," "Add Spacing," "Remove Spacing," "Americanisms," and "Dates" from top to bottom. The horizontal value axis is labeled "Difference in Average WER from Whisper large" and uses a linear scale ranging from 0.000 to 0.003, with numeric tick labels at regular intervals of 0.001. Each optimization category contains a group of two horizontal bars representing different models, as indicated by the legend titled "Model." Within each group, the top bar is brown, representing the "NESAC ft model," and the bottom bar is dark green, representing the "SESHA ft model." Every bar is visually emphasized with an annotation at its right end displaying its exact numerical value. For the "Normalised" category, the NESAC model is 0.00334 and the SESHA model is 0.00323. In "Add Spacing," the values are 0.00319 (NESAC) and 0.00344 (SESHA), with the latter being the longest bar in the chart. For "Remove Spacing," the values are 0.00311 (NESAC) and 0.00306 (SESHA). Under "Americanisms," the NESAC model shows 0.00299 and the SESHA model shows 0.00302. Finally, for "Dates," the NESAC model is 0.00257 and the SESHA model is 0.00228, which is the shortest bar overall. The categories are not strictly sorted alphabetically or numerically.
